Premium Hybrid Scroll Container

This component merges the performance of native compositor-driven scrolling with the pixel-perfect styling of custom scrollbars.

Try scrolling using your wheel, trackpad, or touch screen. In custom mode, you will see a subtle glassmorphic track and thumb that auto-hides after 1.5s of inactivity.

In native mode, we can style the browser's scrollbars using native APIs (like ::-webkit-scrollbar and scrollbar-width) injected directly via CSS style rules.
